title: FCAI-X is the next AI research Flagship
content:
The Research Council of Finland has selected six centers of excellence to the Finnish Flagship Programme. Of these, Aalto University coordinates the Finnish Centre for Artificial Intelligence Excellence, FCAI-X, which develops artificial intelligence methods to support research and innovation. Lue tämä suomeksi

Product development, R&D and scientific research across fields follow the same loop: design-build-test-learn. With the assistance of AI and under human guidance, the generation of new ideas, experimentation and discovery in this loop are accelerated. FCAI-X develops the needed AI methods and collaborates with top scientists across seven scientific domains, creating new capabilities and increasing the impact of research supported by AI. FCAI-X builds on the strong foundation of AI and machine learning research of the Finnish Center for AI (FCAI), and brings the broad machine learning expertise of ELLIS Institute Finland to developing the methods and bringing them into practice and applications. 

The Flagship period of FCAI, the Finnish Center for Artificial Intelligence, is ending, but the research continues. Subscribe to the newsletter to stay up to date.
